title: {p} & {v} Soup
steps: Brown the {p} in a large pot, then set aside on a clean plate.
Soften the {v} with the {spice} in the same pot, about 8 minutes.
Add the {sauce}, the {p} and enough water or stock to cover, then simmer 25 minutes, until everything is cooked through and any meat is at least 165°F / 74°C inside.
Stir in the {s}, simmer until just tender, and season to taste.
tip: Let beans and veg do the work: skip the cream and go easy on the cheese.
